title: A Demon General Blocks the Way
next_chapter_hook: When Blood Moon turned around, a low voice spanning ten thousand years came from the mountain peak: 'You've finally arrived, child of the Chen family.'

text.content: The dark passage was deep and gloomy, Chen Ji's footsteps never stopped, the Tianji Record in his arms so scalding it seemed to burn through his flesh. That aura of fate, identical to that of the demonic path commander in Chapter 777, was like a lighthouse in the deep sea, pulling him forward step by step. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly in the pages, yet remained uncharacteristically silent, as if waiting for something.

Chen Ji sneered in his heart. For ten thousand years, what had that commander been waiting for? The holder of the Tianji Record Fragment? Or... the bloodline of the Chen family? He touched his chest, where hung a jade pendant he had never shown anyone—Chen Nian's only keepsake before she disappeared. The threads of fate intertwined in the darkness, and he was stepping into a web that had long been woven.

choice.prompt: The aura of fate grew increasingly intense ahead, Chen Ji sensed a powerful consciousness approaching—that was the aura of a demonic path battle general level. How do you choose to respond?

choices.text: Release your aura and face the enemy head-on
choices.description: Since the other party wishes to test, why not appear in your strongest form and strike first to dominate.
choices.visible_reward: Blood Moon acknowledges, the path clears
choices.risk_hint: Exposing your strength may attract more attention

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his True Qi suddenly erupted outward. Though playing the role of a废物 (waste), the foundation bestowed by the Tianji Record Fragment far exceeded those of his level, in an instant the dark passage was filled with raging winds and clouds, a brilliant Spiritual Light shot straight up to the heavens. He wanted to see, just how formidable was this number one battle general of the demonic path.

dialogue.content: Since you've come, why hide and cower?

choices.text: Conceal your aura and observe quietly
choices.description: Show weakness to the enemy, let them reveal their cards first, then seek flaws to counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Keep your trump cards and strike later
choices.risk_hint: May be looked down upon by the enemy, missing the opportunity to take the lead

text.content: Chen Ji concealed his aura, suppressing his cultivation to Foundation Building early stage level, slowed his footsteps, his expression unchanged. He never fought battles without certainty—if the other party wanted to test, then let them make the first move.

Suddenly, a blood-red light gleamed at the end of the dark passage, thick bloody stench rushing toward them, nearly causing nausea. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a tall figure slowly emerged from the blood light—that person wore pitch-black battle armor, eyes like a blood moon hanging in the sky, surrounded by the wailings of countless wronged souls.

dialogue.content: Blood Moon... The chief among the four demonic path battle generals?

text.content: That figure paused slightly, clearly not expecting a Foundation Building waste to一口道破 (immediately recognize) his title. Blood Moon's lips curved into an amused smile, his voice like whispers from the abyss of nine hells: 'Interesting, a servant disciple from Tianqing Sect actually knows this general's name.' He walked forward slowly, each step making the earth tremble slightly, 'How did you find your way here?'

Chen Ji did not answer, just quietly looking at Blood Moon. Blood Moon's strength he already knew from the foresight in Chapter 777—half-step Ultimate, one step away from the Ultimate realm, one of the top combat powers in this world. Yet Chen Ji was not afraid. The trump cards in his hand were far more numerous than Blood Moon could imagine.

Blood Moon, seeing no response, a trace of impatience flashed in his eyes, the blood aura around him suddenly surged. In an instant, a world-destroying pressure descended, the stone slabs beneath Chen Ji's feet cracked instantly. Yet Chen Ji remained motionless, his expression as calm as an ancient deep well. He looked at Blood Moon, the corner of his mouth slightly raised.

choice.prompt: Blood Moon tests with pressure, what is your response?

choices.description: Use their own methods against them, crush the enemy's psychological defenses with words.
choices.visible_reward: Provoking Blood Moon may gain more information
choices.risk_hint: Provoking the enemy may invite stronger attacks

dialogue.content: Is this all the pressure you've got?

text.content: Chen Ji laughed lightly, his voice soft but clearly entering Blood Moon's ears: 'Trying to intimidate people with half-step Ultimate? The demonic path commander in Chapter 777 had much more dignity than you.' These words were like a blade piercing the vital point, Blood Moon's expression suddenly darkened.

choices.text: Silent response, using stillness to control movement
choices.description: No words, no anger, letting all the enemy's attacks hit nothing but cotton.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, psychologically take the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji just quietly looked at Blood Moon, his gaze calm without a trace of wave. This silent contempt was more lethal than any words. Blood Moon's brow furrowed slightly, he had seen too many people trembling and begging under this pressure, yet never such a calm gaze.

Blood Moon withdrew the pressure, his amused expression deepening: 'Interesting, no wonder the commander specially instructed, if anyone enters this passage, have this general test them personally.' He crossed his arms, his blood-red eyes examining Chen Ji: 'Tell me, what qualification do you have to request an audience with the commander?'

Chen Ji said calmly: 'Qualification? I have the Tianji Record Fragment, I know what happened and what will happen within the next three hours. Is this qualification enough?' A flash of surprise crossed Blood Moon's eyes, then turned into wild laughter: 'Hahaha! Tianji Record? That thing cursed by the Heavenly Dao?' He laughed until he rocked back and forth, 'Boy, do you know the fate of all previous Tianji Record holders?'

Chen Ji was unmoved: 'I know. All died, killed by the backlash of the Heavenly Dao.' Blood Moon's laughter stopped abruptly, his gaze turning sharp: 'Since you know, why still dare to use it?' Chen Ji smiled faintly, taking the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, golden light blooming in the dark passage, illuminating Blood Moon's expression shifting between gloom and uncertainty: 'It's not a matter of daring or not, it's that I must use it.'

dialogue.content: I want to find a person.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried undeniable determination: 'My sister, Chen Nian. She was taken by the Holy Sect, becoming the so-called 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'. I want to bring her home.' Blood Moon was silent for a moment, then suddenly asked: 'Do you know what a Heavenly Fate Lock Key is?' Chen Ji nodded: 'I know. She is the key to unsealing the Heavenly Dao's seal, and also a crucial piece in the Heavenly Dao's chess game.'

Blood Moon's expression turned strange: 'You know everything?' Chen Ji closed the book, a cold smile at the corner of his mouth: 'I can see what happens within three hours in the future, as long as I am willing to pay enough Heavenly Fate points. What do you think, is there anything I don't know?' At this moment, Blood Moon's gaze toward Chen Ji completely changed—no longer the contempt of examining prey, but the wariness of facing an equal existence.

choice.prompt: Blood Moon seems hesitant about letting you pass, how do you further persuade him?

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record, display the foresight
choices.description: Show Blood Moon the abilities of the Tianji Record, proving you have the capital to speak with the commander.
choices.visible_reward: Blood Moon fully acknowledges, you gain qualification to ascend the peak
choices.risk_hint: Consumes Heavenly Fate points, and partially exposes abilities

text.content: Chen Ji opened the Tianji Record, between flashes of golden light, a blurry image emerged—that was the scene at the mountain peak, a towering figure standing with back turned, surrounded by chaotic aura. Blood Moon's pupils constricted, that figure in the image was the commander he had followed for three thousand years!

dialogue.content: The one you've followed for three thousand years is now waiting for my arrival.

choices.text: Propose conditions, mutual benefit and win-win
choices.description: Not pressuring with strength, but offering the other party an irresistible exchange condition.
choices.visible_reward: Don't expose trump cards, obtain equal exchange

dialogue.content: I can help you see something, about your own future.

text.content: Chen Ji closed the book, looking meaningfully at Blood Moon: 'Don't you want to know, where the path you've pursued your entire life ultimately leads?' Blood Moon's eyes slightly changed, at this moment, he was shaken.

After a long silence, Blood Moon suddenly laughed toward the sky, laughter echoing through the dark passage, startling countless bats to scatter. He laughed until tears nearly flowed, at the moment the laughter abruptly stopped, the gaze toward Chen Ji carried a hint of acknowledgment: 'Good! Good one, boy of the Chen family!' He stepped aside, the blood-red cape billowing behind him.

dialogue.content: The commander was right, in this chaotic world, only variables can break the deadlock.

text.content: Blood Moon stepped forward, nearly face to face with Chen Ji, his height a full head taller, looking down at this seemingly weak youth: 'Chen Ji, waste servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, holder of the Tianji Record Fragment, last bloodline of the Chen family...' He listed item by item, his voice gradually lowering, 'Too much fate that shouldn't belong to you wraps around your body.'

Chen Ji met his gaze,丝毫不退 (un flinching): 'So what?' The corner of Blood Moon's mouth rose again, this time a genuine smile: 'Nothing much. This general is just reminding you of one thing—' He leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, his voice like a ghost whispering: 'The commander has been waiting for you, for ten thousand years.'

Ten thousand years. Chen Ji's heart shook, yet his expression remained unchanged. Ten thousand years, what an incredibly long time, enough to turn seas into mulberry fields, to make immortals and gods fall like rain. What relationship did this demonic path commander have with the Chen family? What connection with the Tianji Record? Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly in the pages, seeming to want to say something, yet forcibly restraining itself.

After Blood Moon finished speaking, he turned toward the mountain peak, his cape stirring up a gust of wind smelling of blood. He didn't say more, only pausing at the turning, without looking back he tossed out a sentence: 'Follow. At the summit of Kunlun, the commander awaits you.' Chen Ji took a deep breath, put the Tianji Record into his chest, and walked forward with big strides. The chess game of fate was finally about to reveal its mysterious veil.

The wind at the mountain peak was biting cold, cold as万年寒冰 (eternal ice). When Chen Ji stepped onto the final stair, he saw a massive altar, and above the altar, a towering figure stood with back turned, hands clasped behind. That figure was surrounded by chaotic aura, as if it had existed since ancient times, waiting for his arrival.
